images.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target is the attached enlarged Mirea face crop. Remove BOTH eyes completely (irises, sclera, eyelash lines, eyelids) and remove the mouth completely, restoring seamless pale peach skin, natural cheek blush, tiny nose and original light/shadow. This is a clean facial base for a layered 2D rig. Preserve ALL hair, hair strand outlines, eyebrows, nose, facial contour, composition, head tilt, framing and exact positions. Do not smooth or beautify the entire illustration. Preserve soft lavender/peach anime painterly style. Same full crop framing as reference, no margins or re-centering, no labels. Transparent background where applicable; face skin must be fully opaque. Keep original image aspect ratio.

Use case: illustration-story. Reference image: enlarged original Mirea face. Create ONE isolated complete white sclera asset for her viewer-left lower-position eye. NO iris, NO pupil, NO lashes, NO eyeliner, NO skin. The full softly rounded almond/oval eyeball white is uninterrupted, including the pixels formerly hidden beneath the iris and upper eyelid. Match this eye's original perspective/head tilt and soft creamy-white shading with pale lavender upper shadow, no sharp outline, transparent background. Single asset centered with generous transparent margin. Soft painterly anime style exactly like reference, no text, grid, labels or other objects.
